findings.highlight: Magic is an equivalent exchange after all. No matter what kind of magic it is
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術っていうのはね、結局は等価交換なの。どんな神秘だって
findings.governingReading: Rin says Magecraft ultimately operates through equivalent exchange, then broadens the proposition to every mystery.
findings.explanation: Using magic for both terms erases the deliberate shift from 魔術 to 神秘 in a core system explanation.

findings.highlight: a deteriorated version of that one magic
findings.evidenceJa: ある魔術が劣化しただけのモノ
findings.governingReading: Rin tentatively infers that his art is a degraded form of some unnamed Magecraft.
findings.explanation: That one magic falsely suggests a previously identified or uniquely privileged “Magic,” distorting both reference timing and technical category.
